title: Box Truck Log App with Admin/User Roles, Document Uploads, and Questions

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication and role-based access so the app supports two roles: Admin and User. Users can access their own log entries, uploads, and questions; Admins can access all users’ logs, uploaded documents, and questions.

quotes: I would like to create a web based log for a 28ft box truck , have a admin log and users log which the admin see uploaded  docs and questions

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visitors are prompted to sign in with Internet Identity.
After sign-in, the UI clearly indicates whether the signed-in user is Admin or User.
User-only views do not show other users’ content.
Admin views can list and open content created by any user.
Backend enforces authorization checks (not only the UI).

requirements.text: Create a truck log feature for a 28ft box truck where signed-in users can create, view, edit, and delete their own log entries with at minimum: date/time, optional title, notes, and an optional numeric field (e.g., mileage/odometer). Admins can view all users’ log entries.

quotes: create a web based log for a 28ft box truck , have a admin log and users log

acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can create a new log entry and see it appear in their log list.
A signed-in user can edit and delete their own log entries.
A signed-in user cannot edit/delete log entries belonging to another user.
An admin can view an aggregate list of all log entries and filter/group by user.
Log entries persist across page refreshes.

requirements.text: Add document upload for users: users can upload documents (store file bytes + metadata such as filename, content type, size, upload timestamp) and view/download their own uploads. Admins can view/download all users’ uploaded documents.
acceptanceCriteria: User can upload a document and see it listed with filename, size, and upload time.
User can download/view a previously uploaded document.
Admin can browse documents across all users and download them.
Backend stores document metadata and bytes and returns correct bytes on download.
UI shows a clear error for disallowed/oversized uploads, and the upload does not partially persist.

requirements.text: Add a questions feature: users can submit questions (text + timestamp) and view their own submitted questions. Admins can view questions from all users and manage them by setting a simple status (e.g., Open/Answered) and optionally adding an admin reply.
acceptanceCriteria: User can submit a question and see it listed in their questions view.
Admin can see all users’ questions in an admin view.
Admin can change a question’s status (Open/Answered) and the change persists.
If admin replies are enabled, a user can see the admin reply for their question.
Backend prevents non-admins from changing other users’ question status/replies.

requirements.text: Provide an Admin dashboard (“admin log”) and a User dashboard (“users log”) with navigation between: Truck Logs, Documents, and Questions. The Admin dashboard must include overviews and lists for all users’ data; the User dashboard must show only the signed-in user’s data.

quotes: have a admin log and users log which the admin see uploaded  docs and questions

acceptanceCriteria: After sign-in, users land on a dashboard appropriate to their role.
Navigation allows switching between Logs, Documents, and Questions within the role’s permitted scope.
Admin dashboard includes at least: All Logs, All Documents, All Questions views.
User dashboard includes at least: My Logs, My Documents, My Questions views.
Attempting to access admin routes/views as a non-admin redirects or shows an authorization error.

requirements.text: Define a consistent, distinctive visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) appropriate for a “fleet/truck operations log” product, and apply it consistently across dashboards, tables/lists, and forms (avoid a blue/purple theme).
acceptanceCriteria: All primary pages share a consistent layout, typography, and color system.
Forms, buttons, and lists/tables use consistent variants and spacing.
The theme is not dominated by blue/purple as primary branding colors.
The UI is usable on mobile and desktop (responsive layout for dashboards and lists).

requirements.text: Add the required generated image asset(s) to the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the UI (e.g., app header/login screen).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated image files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filenames specified in imageRequirements.required.
At least one primary screen (e.g., header or landing/dashboard) displays the generated image.
No backend endpoints are used to serve the generated static image assets.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all Motoko logic in one main actor file).
Use Internet Identity for authentication (no third-party auth providers).
Do not modify any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
No external databases or third-party storage services; persist data in-canister.
nonGoals: Route planning, GPS/location tracking, or maps/geolocation features.
Real-time chat or WebSocket-based live updates.
Integration with external cloud storage (Google Drive/Dropbox/S3) for documents.

required: Minimal monochrome line-art illustration of a 28ft box truck, front 3/4 view, clean vector style (truck-logo.dim_512x512.png)
